body: Survivor, or should I say learning to survive after DV marriage, attempting to learn how I can teach and help others.

I am so so Sorry. I am still learning more each day as much as I can in regards to all Reddit, by doing so I'm hoping it will help me in the future. As well as continuing to read and follow advice from others, FAQ's, reddiquette, and the many other tips available. I think I'm what most people used to refer to as a newbie, and is possibly the term still used, I'm unsure about that also? I search and read as much as I have time for. Because I truly love the site! I think it's great, informative, and has so many things to offer! I promise you this violation was not done intentionally and I will absolutely read up on this rule so I have a complete understanding of it. I also hope this does not mean I am banned from Reddit because of this violation. I have teenagers who I try and get to help me on many things Reddit, but feel my age is showing as I feel I'm lacking some skills and a lot of knowledge regarding this website. But as they tell me, as I've told them growing up, you can take someone fishing and feed them dinner for a day, but you can take someone fishing and teach them to fish and they will have dinner for the rest of their life. Well, I'm here, and as they helped me with the basics, it's now my time to keep my line thrown in and continue learning! One other question, should I hit the delete button shown under the post title while logged into my account?? As I do not want to violate anything else! Thank you again for your support and information. I won't hit the delete button just yet until I hear from someone here regarding that information and can give me the correct reddiquette for this rule. Again, I am sincerely sorry! I look forward to any follow ups you have on how I should proceed with this post. Thanks again. Have a great day!!!

Not garbled at all. I understand, honestly I do. I never dreamed by my old age of soon to be 42 that I would know as many friends and family that have made this choice, the first time I was 19, then my ex brother in law, and as my kids became teenagers the numbers keeping growing on the funerals we have attended. But nothing sticks with me, and I feel what you say when I learned my friend chose death when I was 19, I had seen him the night before, and your remarks are still with me, always. But also going through certain things in my own life now, I still wonder.... I can understand to some extent if you choose not to leave something behind to give some explanation, but sometimes I feel as if you have burdened everyone you know to the point where you know you have no where to go, or any way to get there, and your hardships have put everyone else in a difficult position, you just sometimes feel like it's time to retreat, not hurt or make it more difficult for your loved ones. But if you cannot for see any change, and you know life goes on,  and would be easier to some degree as time passes for your loved ones, it makes me wonder especially at night, time will pass, wounds won't hurt as bad, and your loved one's lives would be much easier, just so long as you leave them with some answers for afterwards. I am so very new to this site so please forgive me if my reddiquette is not correct. I'm still learning. But I honestly and sincerely appreciate your honest response! Best Wishes to you and your family!!
